title: Is Nebius’s Multi‑Year Meta and Microsoft Deals Reshaping The Investment Case For Nebius Group (NBIS)?
title_zh: Nebius 的多年 Meta 和微软交易是否会重塑 Nebius Group (NBIS) 的投资案例？
summary: Nebius Group’s recent investor updates highlight its evolution into a pure-play AI infrastructure provider, underpinned by multi‑year contracts with Meta and Microsoft, including agreements worth about US$3 billion and US$19 billion and a backlog exceeding US$20 billion.
summary_zh: Nebius Group 最近的投资者更新突显了其已发展成为一家纯粹的人工智能基础设施提供商，并以与 Meta 和微软的多年合同为基础，其中包括价值约 30 亿美元和 190 亿美元的协议以及超过 200 亿美元的积压订单。

summary_zh: 长期以来，谷歌地图在韩国提供的功能有限，原因是出于安全考虑而限制导出详细地理数据。

title: Nebius AI Cloud Deals With Meta And Microsoft Meet Valuation Debate
title_zh: Nebius AI Cloud 与 Meta 达成交易，微软遭遇估值争论
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) has secured multi year AI cloud infrastructure contracts with Meta and Microsoft. The company is expanding data center capacity to support growing demand for next generation AI workloads.
summary_zh: Nebius Group（纳斯达克GS：NBIS）已与 Meta 和 Microsoft 签订了多年人工智能云基础设施合同。该公司正在扩大数据中心容量，以满足对下一代人工智能工作负载不断增长的需求。
